title: Teitunnel project file (teitunnel.yml)
description: A project's routes, shares, Snapshots and local domains, applied with `teitunnel up` or by opening the folder in Teitunnel. Never put secrets here: refer to them with { env: NAME } or { keychain: NAME }.

version.description: The schema version. This file follows version 1.

project.description: The project's name, used by the {project} placeholder. Default: the name in package.json, Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml, composer.json or go.mod, else the folder's name.

account.description: The Cloudflare account (its name or id). Needed when several accounts are connected.

routes.description: Permanent routes: public hostnames on your domains that reach services on this machine.

shares.description: Shares that run while `teitunnel up` (or the app, with the project open) runs.

snapshots.description: Static copies published to your Cloudflare account (online while this computer sleeps).

localDomains.description: Local HTTPS names for ports on this machine, like shop.localhost.

protection.description: Reserved for a later version (passwords and gates on shares). This version ignores it and warns.

hostname.description: A hostname on one of the account's domains. May use the placeholders {branch}, {user} and {project}, e.g. "{branch}-{project}.example.com".

login.description: Require a Cloudflare Access login: email addresses, or @domain for everyone at a domain.

secretRef.description: A secret, by reference: an environment variable of the process applying the file, or an entry in the OS keychain under Teitunnel's service. Never the secret itself.

duration.description: 90s, 30m, 2h or 7d (a bare number is minutes); at most 90 days.

originRequest.description: Origin settings, as in cloudflared's originRequest.

origin.description: Where traffic goes: a port (3000), host:port, or a URL (http, https, tcp, ssh, rdp, smb).

path.description: Only requests whose path matches this regex, e.g. ^/api.

tunnel.description: One of this machine's tunnels, by name (default: the default tunnel).

skipLogin.description: Paths under the route that skip its login, e.g. /webhooks, so webhook senders and other machines get through (needs login; at most 10).

url.description: The service's URL, instead of port.

hostname.description: A hostname on one of your domains (a temporary route, removed when the share stops). Without it: a Quick Share at a random trycloudflare.com address.

inspect.description: Record its traffic in the inspector (default: true).

hostHeader.description: The Host header sent to the service: "auto" (default: dev servers that need their own address get it), false to pass the visitor's through, or a value such as localhost:5173.

source.description: A folder published as it is, or a project built first; relative to teitunnel.yml.

hostname.description: A hostname on one of your domains; without it, the account's workers.dev address.

spa.description: Serve index.html for unknown paths (single-page apps).

expires.description: Delete it after this long (whole days, e.g. 30d).

wildcard.description: Subdomains (*.name.localhost) go to the same port.
